Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)

Arm blades designed with lethality and concealment in mind. As effective as they are flashy.

Cyberarm/Cyberleg Option. Requires 2 Option Slots. A One-Handed Excellent Quality Heavy Melee Weapon that can be successfully concealed without a Check and can be drawn and stowed without an Action. While the weapon is “popped up,” the user can’t hold anything in this arm’s hand (Cyberlegs do not have this downside, unless they’re currently using a Prehensile Cyberfoot). When purchased twice and installed in two paired Cyberlimbs, the user can negate the normal movement penalty for climbing while both weapons are popped up.

Type: Cyberarm
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 2

Foundry notes:

  • Cyberware items have no Quality field, so the Excellent Quality is in the text only.
  • Corgo allows this in a Cyberleg too; the item is typed as a Cyberarm option, so install it by hand for a leg.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
